scope: Offline retrieval screen only. No production activation, Mistral fallback, 1024-dimension migration, or write to the source database.

model.family: local Ollama nomic-embed-text tag; underlying release not separately resolved
model.normalization: L2 unit normalization after inference; nearest-neighbor metric is L2 over normalized vectors.

context.prompt_length_measure: Ollama API prompt_eval_count from one-input-per-request responses; record character and UTF-8 byte lengths as well.
context.overlength_handling: Record an input rejected specifically for context length, omit only that input from the vector index, and continue; do not retry with truncation. Record prompt_eval_count as unavailable for rejected inputs. Abort on any other error.

ollama.request_pattern: One POST /api/embed request per input, sequentially; keep_alive=10m.

corpus.selection: All non-empty rows matching the current profile allowlist, ordered by chunk id; this is the existing 4,732-chunk profile slice, not a sample of the full 270,498-chunk database.
corpus.source_mode: SQLite URI mode=ro; vectors are held in a transient in-memory sqlite-vec index; source database is never modified.

evaluation.primary_metric: Exact normalized expected-title retrieval at ranks 1 and 1-5 after applying the existing maximum of 2 chunks per exact book title.
evaluation.secondary_outputs: Raw chunk top-5 for reproducibility; capped top-5; candidate K used; title hashes; per-input prompt counts; embedding hash match against the previous exact run.
evaluation.reproducibility_checks: Compare all raw embedding hashes and raw top-5 candidate lists with the previous committed screen before interpreting the capped output.

interpretation_limits: The query set and corpus are unchanged from the preceding exploratory screen; the 48 records are hand-authored probes, not blind independent gold labels.
The corpus is the 4,732-row profile-filtered slice, not the complete 270,498-row library and not a full reindexing trial.
The installed model is a 768-dimensional local Ollama tag and is distinct from the Nomic Embed v2 MoE run in the historical artifact.
Capping at two chunks per exact book title matches the local retrieval diversity rule, but no Nomic distance threshold is applied or validated.
No human relevance adjudication is performed; title recall and ranking concentration do not prove semantic answer quality.

live_policy.candidate_k_expansion: Double until 5 usable candidates or min(index_rows, 4096).
live_policy.similarity_threshold: None; no Nomic threshold is validated. Do not reuse BGE/Mistral thresholds.
